title: "PRAC 3"

**Question 1**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
data(flights, package = "nycflights13")
data1 <- as_tibble(flights)
data1
```

**Question 2**

```{r}
flight1 <- flights |> 
  filter(month == 1)
carrier_vec <- flight1 |> 
  distinct(carrier)
carrier_dist_vec_mean <- carrier_vec |> 
  length()|>
  vector(mode = "numeric")
carrier_dist_vec_sd <- carrier_vec |> 
  length() |> 
  vector(mode = "numeric")
carrier_dist_vec_mean <- flight1 |> 
  group_by(carrier) |> 
  summarise(mean_dist = mean(distance))
carrier_dist_vec_sd <- flight1 |> 
  group_by(carrier) |> 
  summarise(sd_dist = sd(distance))
dist_table <- tibble(carrier_vec,carrier_dist_vec_mean[,2],carrier_dist_vec_sd[,2])
dist_table
```

**Question 3**

The sd will be NA when there is only 1 observation while it will be zero if multiple observation of the same value.
